tools.emulator: VICE MCP v3.14.0 macOS arm64 headless (dummy audio)

exclude: Live VIC screen output and sprite pointers. Title backdrop and records are counted at their sources.
Relocation residue. Matches the $C000–$CFFF image in 4015 of 4096 bytes. The live vectors and direct references select the $C000 copy, and the VIC sees character ROM in this window in bank 0.
Live character window populated from the title set at $7000 or the factory set at $7800. Both sources and the gameplay glyph update tables are counted.
Memory-image residue after the factory energy routine ends at $64B2. Repeated page structures have no identified game reader, vector or VIC pointer.
Unpacked residue between the final lab copy routine and the title sprite records. Execution returns at $9FAE.

Unpacked residue after the completion text. Includes an old tape reader at $A900 and repeating page patterns. The title text and sprite pointer chains stay below it. The game state and vectors begin at $BFED.
Residue between the factory SID code and title SID code. The factory returns to $C029 at $C29C and uses no data here.
Residue after the title SID initialiser jumps back to $C723 and before the title restart entry.
Residue after the title scroll handler exits through $FEBC.
Underlying RAM is a byte-for-byte copy of $E000–$EFFF. Resident code keeps I/O visible, including during the sprite swaps. The VIC remains in bank 0.
